name: cc-testador-subagents
description: Browser-real QA gate for Claude Code. Sits between the Orchestrator and the Executor: ingests a build delivery, drives critical flows in a real browser via Playwright MCP, runs deterministic Playwright specs plus @axe-core/playwright, validates UI/UX against OpenSpec Scenarios and Open Design tokens, and hands a blocking/informative findings report back to the Executor. Read-only: never writes production code, never touches openspec/.
